description: 土石流及大規模崩塌警戒資料 [landslides and debris flows] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 提供土石流及大規模崩塌警戒資料之主要欄位： AlertType(發布警戒種類：D: 土石流警戒(Debris), L: 大規模崩塌警戒(Landslide))、DebrisNo(土石流潛勢溪流編號(土石流警戒才會有值))、LandslideID(崩塌區編號(大規模崩塌警戒才會有值))、LandslideName(崩塌區名稱(大規模崩塌警戒... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-11-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
